conservation.condition_narrative: "Sprayed with butyl methacrylate polymer June 1947 by Keck" (Keck typed label).
conservation.report_notes: Published with corresponding artwork entry in *Georgia O’Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné* (Lynes, 1999), this historical conservation information documents treatment decisions made during the artist’s lifetime. Lynes quotes information found on backing labels, and, when noted, from other sources.

Downtown Gallery, New York, from there purchased by Mr. and Mrs. Anthony Haswell, Dayton, Ohio, in 1965.

remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946 [note of backing inscription 1]. Similar to 'leaves' 1923." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Back, OK initials and star" [not verified]. Pictured in 1924 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 24. Orientation differs from installation photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
